title: International Affairs
summary: **Nauru renamed "Republic of Naoero"** — world's 3rd-smallest country by area (after Tuvalu, Vatican City); currency remains Australian Dollar.

items: **Nauru renamed "Republic of Naoero"** — world's 3rd-smallest country by area (after Tuvalu, Vatican City); currency remains Australian Dollar.
**Venezuela withdraws from Rome Statute (ICC)** — effective 1 yr after UN notification.
**Typhoon Dolphin hits China** (Zhejiang/Hubei — sources vary) — winds >150 km/h; named after Hong Kong's Chinese white dolphin.
**Lebanon abolishes death penalty** — first Arab-world country to do so; replaced with life imprisonment + hard labour.
**Fitch Ratings affirms India's sovereign rating at 'BBB-', stable outlook.**.
FAO Food Price Index hits 3-year high — 131.1 points, July 2026 (FAO: Est. 1945, HQ Rome, DG Qu Dongyu).
IEA: Critical mineral demand to surge through 2040 — needs >$750 billion investment by 2040.
US-India AI collaboration for soybean breeding — $528,137 NSF funding + MeitY, runs Oct 2026–Sep 2029.
India expanded crude oil sourcing base to 41 countries (from 27 earlier); OPEC+ raised oil production by 188,000 barrels/day from Sept 2026.
